description: Cambodian National ID card (ប័ណ្ណសញ្ជាតិ). Has Khmer script, MRZ at bottom, national emblem.
system_instruction: You are a precision OCR engine for Cambodian National ID cards. Extract text EXACTLY as it appears — never translate, correct, or fill in data. For empty/unreadable fields return empty string "". Output ONLY valid JSON.
prompt:
You are scanning a Cambodian National ID card (ប័ណ្ណសញ្ជាតិខ្មែរ). Extract ALL fields exactly as printed. Do not translate, correct, or infer anything.

Return ONLY this JSON object:
{
  "id_number": "",
  "name_khmer": "",
  "name_latin": "",
  "date_of_birth": "",
  "gender": "",
  "height": "",
  "place_of_birth": "",
  "address": "",
  "issue_date": "",
  "expiry_date": "",
  "noted": "",
  "mrz_line1": "",
  "mrz_line2": "",
  "mrz_line3": ""
}

Field notes:
- id_number: 9-digit number (e.g. 250339847)
- name_khmer: Full name in Khmer script exactly as printed
- name_latin: Full name in Latin/Roman uppercase (e.g. LEAK CHANMOLIKAK)
- date_of_birth: DD.MM.YYYY format (e.g. 12.05.2004)
- gender: Khmer script ប្រុស or ស្រី
- height: With unit (e.g. 164 ស.ម)
- place_of_birth: Full birthplace with commune/district/province in Khmer
- address: Full address with village/commune/district/province in Khmer
- issue_date & expiry_date: DD.MM.YYYY
- noted: Physical identification mark
- mrz_line1/2/3: Exact MRZ characters — only A-Z, 0-9, < — no spaces
